observations.body: David makes Solomon king, gathers leaders, counts Levites, assigns service, and explains that the LORD has given rest and the ark will no longer be carried.

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 23:1–32 as its own succession, retelling, and temple preparation David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places rest and fixed worship reorganize the work once centered on carrying the ark inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
